children: New Delhi [India], November 7: Jindal Panther were crowned champions of the Indian Masters (14-goal tournament) after a thrilling 12-11 win over Vimal Arion Achievers in a closely contested final that went to extra time.

In a final that had everything, Jindal Panther held a 10-7 advantage heading into the sixth chukker, with Mr Naveen Jindal contributing with two goals, appearing firmly in control of the contest. However, Vimal Arion Achievers mounted a spirited comeback to take an 11-10 lead, putting the championship within their grasp. Demonstrating tremendous composure and fighting spirit, Jindal Panther fought back to level the scores at 11-11, taking the match into extra time.

With the championship at stake, Matt Perry emerged as the match-winner, scoring the decisive golden goal in extra time to secure a memorable 12-11 victory for Jindal Panther and seal the Indian Masters title.
The final was a testament to the competitive spirit and skill of both teams, with Vimal Arion Achievers putting up a spirited challenge and pushing Jindal Panther all the way to the finish.
The victory marks a spectacular end to the season for Jindal Panther, who demonstrated resilience, teamwork and determination to emerge champions of the prestigious 14-goal tournament.
